 Order

Dated this the 04th day of October, 2024 This Criminal Miscellaneous Case has been filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, (in Short 'B.N.S.S.') to quash Annexure A1 and A2 FIR and Final Report in Crime No.1456/2023 of Sooranadu Police Station,
Kollam District, now pending as SC No.1635/2023 on the files of the Fast Track Special Court under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (in short 'POCSO Act'), Karunagapilly.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioner herein is the sole accused in the above case.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned public prosecutor in detail.
3.

On perusal of the prosecution records, the prosecution alleges commission of offences punishable under Section 376, 376(2)(f), 376(2)(i), 376(2)(n), 354, 354A(1)(i), 354A(1)(iii), 354A(1)(iv) of IPC &
Section 67(A) of Information Technology Act, 2000, (in short 'I.T. Act'), and 2024:KER:74035 Section 3(b), 4, 5-I, 5-m, 5-n, 6, 9-I, 9-m, 9-n, 10, 11(i), 11(iii), 11(iv), 11(vi) and 12 of the POCSO Act by the accused.

4. The prosecution case is that the accused herein subjected the minor victim, aged eight years, to rape and aggravated sexual assault starting from March 2021 till 29.09.2023, and thereby the above offences are committed.

5. While seeking quashment of the proceedings, the learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that now the matter has been settled and an affidavit sworn by the father of the victim has been filed to support the settlement.
He also would submit that there were civil disputes in between them, and this case is foisted on the said back ground.

6. The learned public prosecutor strongly opposed quashment of the proceeding in this case,
involving very serious offences, including offences under the POCSO Act, on the submission that settlement of POSCO cases merely acting on the affidavit of the father of the victim is not 2024:KER:74035 legally permissible.

sentences.text:
On perusing the records and the statements of the witnesses repeated sexual assault against a minor victim aged eight years starting from March 2021 to 29.09.2023 is well made out, primafacie,
warrenting trial of the matter permitting prosecution to let evidence.
In such a case, merely on the ground that the father of the victim filed an affidavit supporting settlement, quashment of the proceedings could not be considered.
Therefore, the quashment sought for is liable to fail and accordingly this petition is dismissed.
Registry is directed to forward a copy of this order to the trial court, within three days, for information and further steps.

Sd/-
A. BADHARUDEEN JUDGE HKH/04.10.2024
